No file changes detected in this version.

- No updates or modifications were made to the skill in version 1.0.1.
- Functionality, behavior, and documentation remain unchanged from the previous release.

Initial release of Celery Task Analyzer.

- Analyzes Celery task configurations for reliability, performance, and debugging.
- Checks retry policies, task routing, serialization, result backends, worker configuration, beat schedules, and task design patterns.
- Produces detailed quality reports with practical risk/fix guidance for each task and setting.
- Designed to help review Celery task definitions, audit production readiness, optimize worker performance, and troubleshoot common Celery issues.
